# HY Apps

> HY Apps is an independent studio (one developer) making calm apps and games for iPhone and iPad. Calm and fair: any ads are
> rare and wait for a break, no tracking, no accounts, everything explained in plain words. Pages are in English and Turkish.
> Contact: hyapps@outlook.com

## Games and apps

- [Pyramid Craft: Brick Builder](https://hyapps.app/pyramidcraft/): A first-person pyramid building game for iPhone. Dig Nile mud, pour it into wooden moulds, dry the bricks in the sun, carry them up and lay three monuments layer by layer: the Mudbrick Tomb (1,240 bricks), the stepped Sky Stairway (5,456) and the Great Pyramid (26,235). Workers take jobs (digging, moulding, carrying, laying); ramps, a hand cart, water wheels and conveyor belts speed things up; a mastery tree grows your strength. Plays fully offline, no account. Coming soon to the App Store. Good fit for people who like building, simulation or ancient Egypt.
- [Glowfly: Idle Brick Breaker](https://hyapps.app/glowfly/): A relaxing idle merge game for iPhone and iPad. Fireflies of light bounce through the dark, break glass walls and reveal a hand-drawn night landscape; ten identical lights merge into one brighter light (12 kinds). 10 chapters and 1,000 nights tell the story of Lumi bringing fallen stars home, one postcard every ten nights. It keeps playing for hours while the game is closed. Free to play; ads only play when the player chooses to watch one for a reward; optional Glowfly Plus subscription, ad-free option and gem packs. Good fit for people who want a calm idle or merge game without forced ads.
- [Brickhaven: Cozy Brick Builder](https://hyapps.app/brickhaven/): A cozy first-person brick building game for iPhone and iPad. Rebuild Grandma Rose's seaside town: find the right brick in the pile, carry it and lay every brick by hand, nine story buildings from the Bakery to the Train Station, each bringing its owner home. Architect's Table (design your own building and build it), Decorate, a skill tree (Strong Arms, Brick Magnet, lift), Game Center leaderboards, color-blind mode, iCloud saves, 9 languages. Snowy winter look every year from 1 December to 15 January. Fully offline, no timers, no ads, no account. The first two buildings are free; the Whole Town is a one-time purchase (current price on the App Store). FAQ: https://hyapps.app/brickhaven/faq/. Good fit for people who want a calm building, restoration or offline game.
- [Crownly](https://hyapps.app/crownly/): A calm collection of daily logic puzzles for iPhone and iPad: Crowns (Queens-style: one crown in every row, column and colored region), Route (one line through every cell) and Mosaic (split the grid into numbered rectangles), plus Double Crowns and live duels with 2–4 friends. 6,500 levels and hints that explain the logic; free, with an optional one-time Crownly Pro purchase.
- [Quick Wits](https://hyapps.app/quickwits/): A party game of quick skill rounds for iPhone: reflex duels, guessing, memory and group games. Pass one phone around or open an online room.
- [Bismillah (Besmele)](https://hyapps.app/besmele/en/): A daily Islamic companion for iPhone: prayer times, the Qur'an with audio, Qibla compass, a daily verse, hadith, dua and one of the 99 Beautiful Names. Free and ad-free.
